commit_message: Add AI Studio session rename and deletion
pr_title: AI Studio: add session rename and deletion
pr_body:
## Summary

- add persistent AI Studio session rename without changing session identity
- add confirmed local session deletion with active-run and in-progress-answer protection
- remove local session workspaces, baselines, run artifacts, and asset staging on delete
- preserve deliberately exported project-shared session history
- add persistence and cleanup tests

## Validation

- Windows affected validation
- Editor visual validation through the ADR First Release suite
